quiz.question: What is a constructor in Dart and when does it run?

answers.answer: A function that runs when the program starts
A special function used to destroy objects when they are no longer needed
A regular method that must return a value
A special function that runs when an object is created to help initialize it

quiz.question: Which of the following is a valid constructor definition for a Player class in Dart?

answers.answer: Player(String n, int a, String t) { name = n; age = a; team = t; }
void Player(String n, int a, String t) { name = n; age = a; team = t; }
constructor Player(String n, int a, String t) { name = n; age = a; team = t; }
Player(String n, int a, String t) { return Player(); }
"", because strings default to an empty string
Compile-time error, because name must be non-null
null, because name is declared as String? and was never assigned
undefined, because Dart doesn't initialize fields
